summary: Email Activity Admin APIs and PWA Support testing complete. All 14 backend tests passed (100%) and all frontend UI tests passed. New features verified: GET /api/billing/admin/email-activity returns email events with summary counts, GET /api/billing/admin/email-activity/export downloads CSV successfully, Email Activity Panel displays in billing intelligence tab, Download App buttons present on landing page and billing page, manifest.json and service-worker.js are accessible. Core flows (registration, login, billing) remain working.

issues: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility warning in console)

critical_code_review_comments: Email activity logging in email_service.py correctly logs all email events (sent, failed, skipped) with proper metadata
EmailActivityPanel component has proper data-testid attributes for testing
InstallAppButton handles browser install prompt availability gracefully with fallback toast message
Service worker implements proper caching strategy with cache-first for static assets
manifest.json has all required PWA fields (name, short_name, start_url, display, icons)
seed_data_creation: Multiple test companies and employees created during backend testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email activity admin APIs and PWA support are fully functional. Email events are logged to email_events collection and displayed in the billing intelligence tab. CSV export works. Download App buttons handle non-supported browsers gracefully. Resend remains in sandbox mode so emails fail gracefully for unverified recipients.

email_activity_api.GET /api/billing/admin/email-activity: Returns items array and summary counts (total, sent, failed, skipped)
email_activity_api.GET /api/billing/admin/email-activity/ex: Returns CSV file with proper headers and content-disposition
email_activity_api.authentication: Both endpoints require valid auth token (return 401/403 without)

email_activity_ui.email_activity_panel: Displays in billing intelligence tab with summary cards and event rows
email_activity_ui.download_csv_button: Triggers CSV download with success toast
email_activity_ui.event_details: Shows subject, recipient, type, status, timestamp, and provider message

pwa_support.manifest.json: Accessible at /manifest.json with all required PWA fields
pwa_support.service-worker.js: Accessible at /service-worker.js with proper caching strategy
pwa_support.download_app_buttons: Present on landing page (nav + hero) and billing page quick actions
pwa_support.install_prompt_handling: Graceful fallback message when browser doesn't support install prompt

core_flows.registration: Works correctly, triggers welcome email event

email_integration_status.note: Resend sandbox mode causes emails to fail for unverified recipients, but all events are properly logged to email_events collection and visible in admin dashboard
